free_tier.stated: No free allowance is stated on the OpenAI-compatibility API reference: it documents calling model APIs with an API key and billing is handled in the MaaS console.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI-compatible chat completions with a Bearer API key
chaining: an API key is required and no free token grant is documented on this page

limits.value: Bearer API key required; no free allowance stated

identity_cost.detail: a Huawei Cloud account and a MaaS API key; no identity gate beyond an account is stated on this page

reliability_note: the API is supported only in the south-west (Guiyang-1) region, a regional constraint

evidence.proved: the OpenAI-compatible base URL is api.modelarts-maas.com/openai/v1

notes: The doc URL is an API specification with no free-tier statement; other Huawei MaaS routes were walled (broker-exit-1). No free allowance could be verified.
